summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of 3 Empresa role improvements (verified badge, review-mode onboarding EMP-O01, badge absence without KYB). All 4 required points PASS end-to-end via cookie session_token authentication on preview URL.

test_results.1_verified_badge_active: PASS - company-verified-badge visible in header next to 'Empresa E2E QA'. All commercial tabs rendered: overview, stores, products, inventory, deliveries (Mensajería), wallet, tools + kyc + security. No review-nav.
test_results.2_onboarding_review_EMP-O01: PASS - kyb_review_sess shows company-review-nav with exactly 3 tabs (company-tab-overview/kyc/security). All commercial tabs (stores, products, wallet, inventory, deliveries, tools) correctly ABSENT. company-pending-banner shown with company-pending-goto-kyc and company-pending-goto-security CTAs.
test_results.3_kyb_accessible_in_review: PASS - CTA goto-kyc and company-tab-kyc both load company-kyc-page (Verificación de empresa) with Código fiscal, Dirección legal textarea, and the 3 documents (Código/certificado fiscal, Licencia operativa, ID del representante legal). Seguridad tab loads 2FA 'Verificación en Dos Pasos' screen.
test_results.4_badge_absent_without_KYB: PASS - company-verified-badge NOT present in header for kyb_review_sess (under_review account without verified KYB).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: label 'Mensajería' uses tab id 'deliveries' (not 'messaging'). Current test request listed 'company-tab-messaging' which does not exist; actual testid is company-tab-deliveries. No bug — just a naming inconsistency between label and id.
seed_data_creation: None (preserved existing seeded accounts test_session_empresa_e2e_X and kyb_review_sess).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie-based auth is required (login by email blocked by captcha). Use context.add_cookies with session_token value for domain p2p-exchange-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' not 'networkidle' (posthog keeps network busy). CompanyPanel REVIEW_TABS live in /app/frontend/src/pages/CompanyPanel.jsx; the Mensajería tab id is 'deliveries' not 'messaging'.
